summary: Iteration-5 (direct gallery upload via Emergent object storage) validated end-to-end. Found and FIXED one backend bug: `kind` field on POST /api/admin/upload was declared as `kind: str = 'misc'` which FastAPI treats as a query param — the frontend sends it in multipart FormData, so backend silently fell back to 'misc' for EVERY upload. All doctor/service/gallery/blog/logo/hero uploads were landing in carewithus/misc/. Fixed by importing `Form` and changing to `kind: str = Form('misc')`. Added regression guard test `test_upload_kind_field_is_respected` that uploads with each valid kind and asserts the returned path matches. Backend: 52/52 pytest pass (all 43 iter-4 regression + 8 new upload/media tests + 1 kind-regression guard). Frontend E2E verified: admin login → doctors edit → uploader dialog shows Upload/URL modes correctly → set_input_files on hidden [data-testid='doc-form-photo-uploader-file-input'] triggers POST /api/admin/upload (200, path='carewithus/doctors/...' after fix, url='/api/media/carewithus/doctors/...'), toast 'Uploaded' shown, preview updates with naturalWidth=20, Save PUT /api/admin/doctors returns 200, refreshing /doctors public page renders the uploaded image via SafeImage/resolveImageUrl (absolute URL with backend host prepended, naturalWidth=20, no 404). Verified all uploader testids present: settings-logo-uploader, settings-hero-image-0, svc-form-image-uploader, gal-form-image-uploader, blog-form-image-uploader. Navbar logo still 7g69kpcj wooden CARE WITH US (naturalWidth=1254). Auth: POST /api/admin/upload without token → 401 (verified). MIME reject: text/plain → 400 'Unsupported file type'. Oversize (>15MB) → 400 'File too large'. GET /api/media/{path} → 200 with correct Content-Type and PNG bytes; nonexistent path → 404. Note: `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` is set correctly by backend (verified via localhost:8001) but the preview/Cloudflare ingress rewrites it to `no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate` for all public routes — this is an infrastructure behavior, not a code bug.

minor.issue: Backend sets `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` correctly, but the preview ingress/Cloudflare overrides it to `no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate`. Environment behavior, not a code fix — in prod deployment (different edge) images will be cached correctly. Verified header is correct when hitting backend directly at localhost:8001.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED (by testing agent): backend/server.py upload endpoint had `kind: str = 'misc'` — FastAPI treats untyped defaults as query params when File(...) is present, so the multipart `kind` field was silently ignored. Fixed to `kind: str = Form('misc')` and added regression test. This was a real user-visible bug: every upload landed in `carewithus/misc/` regardless of context (doctors/services/gallery/blogs/logo/hero) — file organization was broken.

storage.py init_storage lazily initializes and caches _storage_key (module-global). Good, but note: uses `requests` (sync) inside async FastAPI endpoint via `put_object`/`get_object` — will block the event loop under load. Consider `httpx.AsyncClient` or `await run_in_threadpool(...)` in a future iteration. Non-blocking for MVP scale.

server.py get_media loads the entire file into memory and returns it as `FastAPIResponse(content=...)`. For large images this uses RAM per request. Consider StreamingResponse for future scale. Non-blocking for 15MB max.
ImageUploader.jsx `absolutize()` duplicates logic that also exists in SafeImage.jsx `resolveImageUrl`. DRY: import and reuse `resolveImageUrl` from `@/components/SafeImage`.

ImageUploader does not surface backend error details clearly — a 500 storage error would show generic 'Upload failed'. Consider showing `err.response?.data?.detail` more prominently (component already reads it, good).
No file-lifecycle management: when a doctor/service is deleted, its uploaded images are NOT removed from `files` collection or object storage (orphaned). Add a soft-delete cascade in future.

No image compression / resize on upload — a user uploading a 15MB phone photo will store 15MB and serve 15MB to every visitor. Consider a Pillow-based resize/webp conversion pipeline in a future iteration.

rca of the issue: Bug: uploads landed in carewithus/misc/ regardless of `kind` passed by frontend. Repro: POST /api/admin/upload with multipart file + form field kind=doctors → response path started with 'carewithus/misc/' not 'carewithus/doctors/'. Root cause: In FastAPI, when a route has `File(...)` in its signature, other plain-typed defaults like `kind: str = 'misc'` are treated as QUERY PARAMETERS, not form fields. Frontend correctly sent `kind` via FormData (multipart body), so the query param was empty and the default 'misc' was always used. Mitigation: import `Form` from fastapi and declare `kind: str = Form('misc')`. Verified fix with new regression test test_upload_kind_field_is_respected that uploads with each valid kind (doctors/services/gallery/blogs/logo/hero) and asserts the returned path starts with the correct folder. Also verified end-to-end via Playwright that a doctor edit form's uploader now produces `carewithus/doctors/...` paths.
